احتجزوا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَجَزُوا (iḥtajazū) /iħ.ta.d͡ʒa.zuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
# اُحْتُجِزُوا (uḥtujizū) /uħ.tu.d͡ʒi.zuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
# اِحْتَجِزُوا (iḥtajizū) /iħ.ta.d͡ʒi.zuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
